method: Ours-TTT (target-tuned): frozen T070-A code, knobs selected on target GT

knob_locations.q_joint: gate asset T022A_gate.json q_joint (FinalOurs.gate) -> ttie/joint_gate.py both_gates: active iff evidence > q_joint
knob_locations.tau: gate asset T022A_gate.json calibration.tau -> ttie/clip_signal.py decisions, ttie/joint_gate.py winning_evidence
knob_locations.probability_threshold: research_log/T067B/core.py choices: first step with probabilities[k]>=.5 (k_FS)
knob_locations.lambda_value: research_log/T070A/infer.py select_trajectory: c['lambda_value']==.875 (T067B GRID values only)

selection.rule: max image-mean PSNR; within PSNR_TIE_DB: max mean RGB-SSIM, then min normalised L1 knob distance, then setting id
selection.scope: union of all rounds' COMPLETE records; L1 ranges over the union of declared settings
